verdict.rationale: Clerky documents a Partner API with REST endpoints such as POST /v1/document_sets, OAuth that is still 'coming soon', and a remote MCP server. Nothing in the evidence mentions any official client SDK or library in any language. A raw HTTP API and an MCP server are adjacent capabilities and do not count as official SDKs.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can build against official SDKs
